step.cmd: Fact-find with the client to determine the number of entitlement weeks the client wants to receive for the correct benefit type (BT).
Determine if the client was contacted during fact-finding:

ul.li: If the client was contacted, go to step 14.
If the client was not contacted or did not reply to the N-10-00-00 letter, go to step 15.
